decisions.decision: Minutes of May 7, 2019 were approved (no motion or vote recorded).
FY19 and FY20 accounts payable warrants were signed.
decisions.quote: a fy19 accounts payable warrant in the amount of $688,136.10 and a fy20 accounts payable warrant in the amount of $771,274.85 were signed.

decisions.decision: Abutter notice distance changed from 300 feet to 200 feet.
decisions.quote: 300 feet was changed to 200 feet for abutters.

decisions.decision: Special event policy edits to be brought back for review in early August.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo suggested having these edits for review in early august.

decisions.decision: Town Manager to check with Executive Assistant Peterson on abutter notification process.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux stated she would check with executive assistant peterson on her process for abutter notification.

decisions.decision: Board agreed on the Town Manager evaluation form items from members' collated choices; Ms. Lemieux to amend the form and provide a final document; labor counsel to be consulted on the evaluation process.
decisions.quote: after collating individual member's choices, it was decided to go with the following:

decisions.decision: Ms. Lemieux to amend the Town Manager evaluation form and present a final version at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will amend the form and provide to the board as a final document at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: Town to proceed with negotiating MS4 Year 2 engineering services with Comprehensive Environmental Inc.
decisions.quote: ultimately, we agreed to proceed with negotiating with comprehensive environmental inc.

decisions.decision: Grade/step classification to be discussed and position advertised, assuming Personnel Committee approves the job description.
decisions.quote: we will discuss the grade/step classification and it will advertised accordingly.
